name: OmarchySS
author: DocwatZ
description: A Spotify player and terminal screensaver with configurable TTFX effects.

barWidget.description: Play Spotify and launch a configurable terminal screensaver.

schema.label: Screensaver text
schema.description: Track shows the current Spotify artist and title.

schema.label: Custom text
schema.description: Used when Screensaver text is Custom.

schema.label: Auto-close after seconds
schema.description: Set to 0 to keep the screensaver open until stopped.

schema.label: Beat-reactive effects
schema.description: Cycle TTFX animations on detected bass beats from local PipeWire audio. Keeps Spotify playing and requires cava.

schema.label: Beat sensitivity
schema.description: Higher sensitivity changes effects on smaller bass transients.

schema.label: Terminal font size
schema.description: Increase this if the screensaver text is too small.

schema.label: Render text as FIGlet art
schema.description: Turns the screensaver text into large ASCII/Unicode block art before animating it. Requires figlet and a selected FIGlet font.

schema.label: FIGlet font
schema.description: A FIGlet font name (standard, big, slant, block, shadow, script, ...) or an absolute path to a .flf file, e.g. ~/.local/share/omarchyss/fonts/MyFont.flf
